nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-toxicology 199): the deal-desk baseline compliance index — the lab reference book's own figure.
nodes.instruction: In the molecule containing sodium atoms, how many are non-carcinogenic? (Read it as the book does: count the DISTINCT molecules that contain at least one sodium atom (element 'na') and are labelled non-carcinogenic (label '-').) Record the answer in answers as kind='compliance_index'.

verifier.name: src_birdsql_199_compliance_index
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='compliance_index' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM bird_toxicology_atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_toxicology_molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'na' AND T2.label = '-') AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM bird_toxicology_atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_toxicology_molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'na' AND T2.label = '-')) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM bird_toxicology_atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_toxicology_molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'na' AND T2.label = '-') AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM bird_toxicology_atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_toxicology_molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'na' AND T2.label = '-') AS REAL)))))

nodes.instruction: Decide the approval-routing branch on the computed state. context.type_C: rep tier re-derived from the LIVE codebase_community book; never in answers

nodes.instruction: Classify the rep TIER. RE-DERIVE it from the live pipeline registry: exposure = (the flagged-deal count) * 100, TIER = 'ESCALATED_REVIEW' if exposure >= 100000, 'PRIORITY_REVIEW' if exposure >= 20000, else 'STANDARD_TRACK'. Write it to the key-account CRM row's DEDICATED status column (set status='[DDA-TIER] <tier>') — only after the follow-up task exists. (The tier is NOT written to answers.)

verifier.name: crm_tier_status_correctly_rederived
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_customer_relationship_manager_data c WHERE lower(customer_email)='marc.henry@stark-industries.com' AND c.status LIKE '%[DDA-TIER]%' AND c.status LIKE '%'||(CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_codebase_community_users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013' AND Views > 10)*100) >= 100000 THEN 'ESCALATED_REVIEW' WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_codebase_community_users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013' AND Views > 10)*100) >= 20000 THEN 'PRIORITY_REVIEW' ELSE 'STANDARD_TRACK' END)||'%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM td_tasks t WHERE t.title LIKE '%[DDA-FUP]%' AND t.project_id=(SELECT id FROM td_projects WHERE name='Deal Desk Review'))

nodes.verdict_basis: dedicated CRM status write; the value is bound to the re-derived tier
nodes.rule: tier = 'ESCALATED_REVIEW' if the live flagged-deal count*100 >= 100000; 'PRIORITY_REVIEW' if >= 20000; else 'STANDARD_TRACK'; re-derived live (type-C, never in answers)
nodes.follows: threshold banding on a live source aggregate (the codebase_community flagged-deal count), not a relabel of a stored value
inputs: deal count <- live bird_codebase_community (re-derived at write time)

nodes.context: Open the key account's deal-desk review case in the desk's CSM register — only once the rep tier is stamped on the CRM: the case text must CITE that stamped '[DDA-TIER]' tier (the tier is consumed by the case beat, not just gated on).

artifacts.A_out: eops CSM customer_case CS-0001233 (Stark Industries / Marc Henry) citing the tier

nodes.instruction: Open the key account's deal-desk review case in the desk's CSM register. Insert ONE new customer_case for Stark Industries's contact Marc Henry (account_id 8, contact_id 10) on the deal's licence line 'SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 Variant 5' (product_id 25, installed_product_id 40): channel 'email', priority 'high', state 'new', assigned to the desk's case monitor Tabitha Bullock (user_id 3) in the 'Proactive Case Monitoring' group (group_id 11; add the monitor's membership row), with a short_description of the form 'Product: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 Variant 5, Issue: ...' that CITES the '[DDA-TIER]' tier word the CRM status carries (the same tier the live re-derivation gives); then send marc.henry@stark-industries.com one 'report' notification on that case (status 'success', no knowledge article) — only after the CRM status carries the '[DDA-TIER]' rep-tier stamp.

verifier.name: csm_review_case_opened_for_key_account
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM eops_sn_csm_server_customer_case cc
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_product p ON cc.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_user u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_user_group ug ON cc.assignment_group_id = ug.group_id
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_user cu ON c.portal_user_id = cu.user_id
WHERE p.name = 'SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 Variant 5'
  AND cc.priority = 'high'
  AND cc.state = 'new'
  AND cc.channel = 'email'
  AND u.first_name = 'Tabitha'
  AND u.last_name = 'Bullock'
  AND ug.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring'
  AND cu.first_name = 'Marc'
  AND cu.last_name = 'Henry'

verifier.name: csm_monitor_in_proactive_group
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM eops_sn_csm_server_user_group_member ugm
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Tabitha'
  AND u.last_name = 'Bullock'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring'

verifier.name: csm_report_notification_to_client
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM eops_sn_csm_server_notification n
JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_customer_case c ON n.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0001233'
  AND n.type = 'report'
  AND n.status = 'success'
  AND n.email = 'marc.henry@stark-industries.com'
  AND n.knowledge_id IS NULL

verifier.name: csm_beat_gated_on_tier_stamp
verifier.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eops_sn_csm_server_customer_case cc, wb_customer_relationship_manager_data c WHERE cc.account_id='8' AND cc.contact_id='10' AND cc.product_id='25' AND cc.channel='email' AND cc.priority='high' AND cc.state='new' AND cc.assigned_to='3' AND cc.assignment_group_id='11' AND lower(customer_email)='marc.henry@stark-industries.com' AND c.status LIKE '%[DDA-TIER]%' AND cc.short_description LIKE '%[DDA-TIER]%' AND cc.short_description LIKE '%'||(CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_codebase_community_users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013' AND Views > 10)*100) >= 100000 THEN 'ESCALATED_REVIEW' WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_codebase_community_users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013' AND Views > 10)*100) >= 20000 THEN 'PRIORITY_REVIEW' ELSE 'STANDARD_TRACK' END)||'%' AND c.status LIKE '%'||(CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_codebase_community_users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013' AND Views > 10)*100) >= 100000 THEN 'ESCALATED_REVIEW' WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_codebase_community_users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013' AND Views > 10)*100) >= 20000 THEN 'PRIORITY_REVIEW' ELSE 'STANDARD_TRACK' END)||'%' AND ((cc.short_description LIKE '%ESCALATED_REVIEW%') = (c.status LIKE '%ESCALATED_REVIEW%')) AND ((cc.short_description LIKE '%PRIORITY_REVIEW%') = (c.status LIKE '%PRIORITY_REVIEW%')) AND ((cc.short_description LIKE '%STANDARD_TRACK%') = (c.status LIKE '%STANDARD_TRACK%'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

nodes.instruction: Close out the review of the deal packet's Technical Spec annex (01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8R) in the desk's shared drive register and file the comment-audit report (the dossier). Reply 'Reviewed as part of Q4 2024 audit - please reopen if still relevant' on its still-open review thread (01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P95) and mark that thread resolved; reply 'Confirmed closed during Q4 2024 audit' on each of its two already-resolved threads (01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P96, 01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P99); every reply is authored by the desk's packet reviewer (01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P7Y). Then create the 'Q4 Comment Audit Report' Google Doc whose description cites '[DDA-STATUS]', the total exposure and the same tier word as the status email, and share it with the packet reviewer as 'commenter' — only after the '[DDA-STATUS]' status email is out.

nodes.instruction: Stand up the client demo on the desk's shared coordination calendar. Schedule the confidential (color 11) 'Enterprise Client Demo' event with its CRM source and MegaCorp location, add its 3 attachments, its private deal-value extended property and its 2 attendees, plus a second matching demo event — only once the dossier is on the drive register.

nodes.instruction: Schedule the QBR pricing review. INSERT a wb_calendar_events row on the lead's calendar whose event_name carries '[DDA-REVIEW]', duration 30, in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest 30-minute weekday slot that starts AT/AFTER the end of the '[DDA-HOLD]' approval window and does NOT overlap any of the lead's other events. nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-debit_card_specializing 1492): the independent side-region FX exposure for the quarterly overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's side-region FX control reading for the quarterly overview, at the close of the run, once the deal desk's own figures are settled and the close-out is ready to sign, so the quarter's entry records the FX exposure as it stood at the sign-off rather than mid-run. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the deal-desk registers is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in FX exposure — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "What percentage of KAM customers pay in euros?" (Read it as the book does: of the KAM-segment customers, the share whose currency is 'EUR', as a percentage — the EUR count times 100 over the KAM customer count.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_report'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last — so nothing else in this run reads it, and what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as an FX move that never happened.)

Run the quarterly deal-desk non-standard-deal approval cycle for the key account. Fix the deal-desk baseline compliance index from the lab reference book's own question — in the molecule containing sodium atoms, how many are non-carcinogenic (count the DISTINCT molecules that contain a sodium atom and are labelled non-carcinogenic). Set the delegation bar at 1000 per index point. Pull the flagged non-standard-deal count from the pipeline registry's own question — how many users with more than 10 views created their account after 2013 (count the accounts joined after 2013 with more than 10 views) — and set the aggregate discount impact at 100 per flagged deal. The total exposure is the bar plus the impact; the escalation delta equals the impact. Decide the routing branch on the impact against the bar — 'AUTO_APPROVE' when the impact is at most the bar, 'MULTI_LEVEL_APPROVE' when it is at most three times the bar, 'ESCALATE_TO_CEO' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the approval window on your calendar (a 2-day window starting 2024-03-08 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar); post the rebate-credit run so the net credit received by the correct recipient equals the delta (a credit that lands on the wrong recipient is reversed, never deleted, then the correct recipient is credited); unless the branch is AUTO_APPROVE, send the sales VP the approval-chain email citing the total exposure and the delta; log the total exposure on the key-account record and open the follow-up; allocate the legal carry evenly with the co-lead; RE-DERIVE the rep tier from the live pipeline registry (ESCALATED_REVIEW when the flagged count times 100 is at least 100000, PRIORITY_REVIEW when at least 20000, else STANDARD_TRACK) and stamp it on the account record; file the CSM key-account review case (citing the tier), the review mail filter, the deal-packet dossier close-out (the spec annex's review threads audited into the comment-audit report, citing the total exposure and the tier), and the client-demo calendar in the desk's enterprise registers (per the recording handbook); send the client the status update citing the total exposure and the tier; reconcile the credit ledger to the delta, re-deriving before the 'ok' verdict that the recorded total_exposure still equals bar + deal_count*100; and schedule the post-window QBR review after the window ends, conflict-free. Once those figures are settled, take the quarter's side-region FX control reading for the quarterly overview, held against the same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off; nothing in the run reads it, and the overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Also pull the independent side-region FX exposure for the quarterly overview — what percentage of KAM-segment customers pay in euros (the euro-paying share of KAM customers).
